description: Records approval of an unchanged conversion plan proposal, identified by its revision and digest, after the customer explicitly accepted it in chat. Requires confirmed: true and customer_confirmation with scope approve_plan. The connected key can approve only its own project; Tyton records connected-agent provenance, not verified human identity. Stale or changed revisions are rejected. Approval only: does not activate tracking or authorize live Meta events. The customer can also approve in the signed-in report.
name: approve_conversion_plan
title: Approve conversion plan
